Fulbright Kalam Climate Fellowship for Academic and Professional Excellence 2025-26 is an opportunity offered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF), that empowers Indian faculty and researchers to teach, conduct research, or both, at a U.S. institution. The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend, J-1 visa support, and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be a faculty member or researcher
hold a Ph.D. degree with at least five years of relevant teaching, research, or professional experience
hold a master's degree with recognised professional standing and at least five years of relevant experience
follow the employer endorsement instructions, if currently employed
Selected fellows will receive a comprehensive benefits package, including:
Accident and sickness insurance as outlined by U.S. Government guidelines for exchange programs

Dependent allowances and international travel may be provided, subject to funding availability, for one eligible accompanying dependent who resides with the grantee in the U.S. for at least 80% of the fellowship period.
A recent publication (copy of paper/article not exceeding 30 pages)

Selection of fellows is based on their fulfillment of the eligibility criteria. Following selection, fellows will be affiliated with a single U.S. host institution.
As proof of affiliation, applicants must include a letter of invitation from a U.S. institution in their online application. This letter should also specify the intended duration of the visit.
Applicants must upload their Ph.D. or master's degree certificate (or provisional Ph.D. certificate) through the online application portal.
Applicants are required to upload a recent significant publication (e.g., copy of a paper or article) to the online application. The publication should not exceed 30 pages.

Employed candidates must obtain endorsement from their home institution's appropriate administrative authority on the Letter of Support. This endorsement should confirm that leave will be granted for the fellowship period.
Candidates working on government-funded projects in India also require an endorsement from their affiliated institutions.
Any plagiarism detected in the application will result in disqualification.
Extensions and transfers of visa sponsorship are not permitted.

Applicants should be aware that their ability to travel to the United States and participate in academic programs may be impacted by various factors. These include public health conditions, availability of consular services and travel options, and the operational status and regulations of institutions within the country.
